messages:
Claire (Partnerships): Ok folks — partner onramp checklist for next Wednesday. short run: landing page, press timing, SI training, listing assets, test tenant, and legal approvals. who can green each?
Ravi (Marketing): Landing page: copy + hero approved, but we need final headshot + partner quote. embargo window we prefer Tue 09:00 PT. need comms lead from partner.
Miguel (Product): SI training: I can run a 45m deep-dive Tue afternoon. Need to know which partner will require private deployment / on-prem walkthrough vs hosted API.
Sam (Eng): For hardware partners we need the edge image validated. Can we get a hardware test unit to our lab by Mon? Otherwise we'll run emulation. Also need billing SKU for marketplace listing — @Ravi can you confirm price tier?
Jill (Legal): I'll review co-marketing language and partner naming today. Any partner-provided logos must come with trademark usage form. Send to legal@redwood.ai
Claire (Partnerships): @Miguel partners: NovaEdge (HW), StratoSI (SI). NovaEdge will want HSM/KMS handshake for the private image. StratoSI wants test tenant + sandbox API keys.
Ravi (Marketing): Pricing — propose introductory tier: $0.20/token equivalent for first 3 months on marketplace listing, then standard. I'll draft the marketplace listing blurb and embed UTMs. Also will own partner quote collection. Deadline EOD Monday.
Sam (Eng): Noted on HSM. We'll need partner contact for key exchange. Miguel can you route their security engineer? If lab unit not possible, we can do remote run with perf logs and a min-hw-emulator snapshot.
Miguel (Product): Looping in their PM. I'll email StratoSI and NovaEdge now with dates. I can also provision a test tenant (redwood-partner-demo) — Sam, can you enable sandbox keys with rate limit 1qps and 50k tokens/day?
Sam (Eng): Yes, provisioning now. ETA for keys: 2 hours. I'll post the key IDs and the sandbox endpoint once ready.
deploy-bot: Deployment note — staging landing page pushed to staging-redwood/partners. Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/partners/novaedge — build passed. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Marketing): Great. Quick ask — press embargo: partners want 08:00 PT embargo window instead of 09:00. Can we land assets earlier? Design needs final logo pack by 10:00 PT Monday.
Claire (Partnerships): Jill / Legal: can you sign off on the partner quote and logo usage by Monday noon? We need final legal thumbs to publish.
Jill (Legal): I'll prioritize. If they send the signed logo usage + short quote by 09:30 Mon we'll be good. Any non-standard IP clauses should be CC'd to me now.
Miguel (Product): NovaEdge asked about a short walkthrough doc for customers on edge deployment (single-node -> cluster). I'll draft a 1-pager and share in #docs. Need a quick diagram from design.
Ravi (Marketing): I'll coordinate with design for the diagram. Also adding UTM and partner partner_id param to all CTAs. 
Claire (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Ravi — marketplace listing + press copy (due Mon EOD). 2) Miguel — send invites to partners + draft 1-pager (due Mon). 3) Sam — sandbox keys + HSM handshake prep (ETA 2h for keys, HSM checklist by Mon). 4) Jill — legal signoff (Mon 12:00). 5) Partners — final logos and quotes by Mon 09:30. Everyone ack if good.
Ravi (Marketing): ack :thumbsup:
Miguel (Product): ack
Sam (Eng): ack — keys posted in #secure-ops once done.
Jill (Legal): ack
Claire (Partnerships): thanks all — I'll follow up with a short Asana board and invite partners to the kickoff slot on Tue 2pm PT.
